thread:
maya: Quick heads-up: Dedicated provisioning quickstart PR has some mismatched examples. Not urgent but want a pass before Monday.

alex_k: Link?

maya: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4523. Issues: YAML uses `reservedPool` but API is `reserved_pool`; autoscale example references deprecated `.autoscale.cooldown`; python snippet calls `provision_capacity` (now `create_capacity`).

jonathan: I can update YAML and add a small migration note for infra scripts. Should we include CLI flag differences?

maya: Yes, please. Add a Migration note under Quickstart covering CLI and SDK renames. @docs-bot regenerate snippets for python/ts/yaml?

docs-bot: snippet-gen: regenerated for `dedicated_capacity` at commit abc123. Links: https://internal/snippets/4523.

alex_k: I'll rewrite the prose and add an autoscale example comparing cooldown vs burst. Example to paste:

```yaml
reserved_pool: my-tenant-pool
autoscale:
  policy: cpu
  threshold: 0.65
  cooldown_seconds: 300
  burst_allowed: true
```

This uses snake_case and `cooldown_seconds`. Also planning a small table explaining cooldown window behavior.

sara: Legal asked to avoid implying the 99.9% applies across merged pools. Can we add a footnote clarifying SLA is per-reserved-pool-shard with link to SLA matrix?

nate: +1. Also add eviction example: `preemptible: true` label and tradeoffs (cheaper but evictable).

maya: Plan: jonathan -> migration note + YAML fix; alex_k -> prose + autoscale snippet + cooldown table; sara -> SLA footnote text; nate -> eviction example + recommended labels. I'll assemble and open an aggregated PR, tag eng-oncall and docs reviewers. Target EOD Friday.

alex_k: Starting prose pass now.

jonathan: Draft branch pushed `docs/dedicated-qstart-fix` and opened PR https://github.com/redwood/docs/pulls/4578 with migration note and updated YAML.

maya: Tiny nit: prefer "tenant unit" wording in migration note. If no objections I'll squash & merge after approvals.
